_doc: Crew Task Order Codes (1997 ship log, checked against ship-log-blank-1.png). sections = [min, max] crew sections. turns: {ad, eg} = g-t's at CQ A-D / CQ E-G; {sk_base: n} = max(1, n + SK mod); {fixed: n}; {until: 'out'|'turn'} = open-ended. SAIL_MAJOR is MS<->PS (2 CS), SAIL_MINOR FS<->MS and FS<->Furl (1 CS); both are plotted as code SAIL.
